in_marathi.name: Akshy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aksh’, meaning ‘eye’, this name symbolizes the unchanging and all-seeing aspect of the divine. In Hindu mythology, the god Agni is also referred to as ‘Aksh’, representing the divine witness that sees all.
